svg.title: Agulhas Return Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 3300 km. Studied 21–60 degrees E reach only; excludes the western genesis and downstream termination. Not a whole-current length. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
